'''September 2000 Williston Park tournament (2 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Williston Park, NY on 2 September 2000. [[Bucksun Lee]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1191">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-03-williston-park-ny-9-2-00-buck-winsd1191/ williston-park-ny-9-2-00-buck-wins], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 3 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-03-williston-park-ny-9-2-00-buck-winsd1191/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Williston Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Bucksun Lee]]
